name: Jahdai
title: Descendants of Caleb
summary: Jahdai is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles in connection with the genealogy of Caleb. He is listed as the father of six sons. Little is known about him beyond his place in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: The sons of Jahdai in the genealogy of Caleb
keyEvents.description: Jahdai is mentioned in the genealogy of Caleb as the father of six sons: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Efa and Shaaph.

keyEvents.title: Part of the genealogy of the tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: Jahdai is placed within the broader genealogy of the tribe of Judah, showing his belonging to one of Israel's most important tribes.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Caleb's lineage
keyEvents.description: Jahdai's mention in connection with Caleb shows his place in a significant Israelite lineage that had great influence in Judah.

keyEvents.title: Preservation of the lineage
keyEvents.description: Jahdai's six sons ensured the continuation of his lineage within the tribe of Judah, which was of great importance for Israel's tribal structure.
